dedupe_keys.name: norway residential ev charging reports and inferred flexibility twelve sites

description: This deposit contains more than 35,000 electric-vehicle charging sessions for 267 user identifiers across twelve Norwegian residential locations. SINTEF and collaborators combine operator reports of plug-in time, plug-out time and charged energy with predicted battery capacities, charging powers and arrival state of charge. Zenodo publishes four CSV files separating charging reports, user predictions, session predictions and hourly predictions, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage spans sites from Asker and Oslo to Trondheim and Bodo; the short metadata do not establish one common observation period. Inferred battery properties and hourly flexibility are model-derived, not direct measurements, and twelve residential sites do not represent every Norwegian charging context. A reviewer-assessed use is simulating residential charging schedules and grid flexibility. model-pypsa and model-sumo provide related energy and mobility tools, although no input conversion was tested. No individual charging records were downloaded or analysed.
name: Norway residential EV charging reports and inferred flexibility, twelve sites
